title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：photographer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 photographer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the painter ① hired the photographer that no visitor in the studio would have described, and he said the hiring was the whole of the season. The ② photographer, meaning the artist itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a photographer, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ photographer in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ photographer at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A photographer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the painter said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the photographer was the whole of the matter, meaning the eye and not the artist. The ⑥ photographer, meaning the eye and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; photographer, he said, is either something you hire or the only word that means both an artist and an eye. He said the eye is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ photographer had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ photographer of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of describing; photographer, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ photographer I remember is the artist described in the catalogue, which closed in 1964 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ photographer, my mother said in 1966, is the only artist that improves by being described; every photographer, she said, is an eye that has agreed to look like an artist. She said the eye was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 摄影师（指画室里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 摄影师（指那位摄影师本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：hire the photographer 请这一位摄影师
D. n. 摄影师（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 摄影师之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的摄影师之事）
F. n. 摄影师（指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 摄影师、眼光（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 眼光（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: hired the photographer that no visitor in the studio would have described
The photographer, meaning the artist itself and not the brush
the photographer at the far easel
the photographer was the whole of the matter
the photographer had become a line in a catalogue
The photographer of the whole thing
A photographer, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: hire the photographer 意为“请这一位摄影师”，1957 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯描述的一位摄影师做了一遍。
photographer 意为“摄影师”，指那位摄影师本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
photographer 意为“摄影师”，指画室里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
photographer 意为“摄影师”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
photographer 意为“摄影师、眼光”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位眼光就是那件事的全部。
photographer 意为“眼光”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位摄影师，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
photographer 意为“摄影师”，指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1962 年这一位成了展品目录里的一行。
photographer 意为“摄影师之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的摄影师之事是一处画室和三个季度的描述。
photographer 意为“摄影师”，我记得的是展品目录里描述过的那一位，1964 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一位。
photographer 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，摄影师是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的摄影师。
